The FloPlast uPVC round running outlet is a crucial component for effective rainwater drainage systems. This robust black uPVC fitting connects 112mm round gutters to 68mm downpipes, ensuring efficient water collection and redirection away from property foundations. It is ideal for new-build projects and refurbishment work, providing a practical solution for reliable roof drainage. The system features pre-lubricated seals and a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip, making installation straightforward for trade professionals. Its compatibility with most major manufacturers offers versatility, and the durable construction delivers long-lasting weather protection.
